title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1979-08-05
taper: Recorded by Augustus Owsley Stanley III (aka Bear)
source: Set 1 and Scarlet Begonias: Bear-sourced cassette. Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 @ 24 bit 96 kHz Set 2 starting at Fire on the Mountain: Anon sourced file (same mix as Bear tape) upsampled to 96kHz to match Bear source
